    What is the average income in New Caney Texas?
    $36,055 a year
    How much does a Full Time make in New Caney, Texas? As of Mar 5, 2026, the average annual pay for a Full Time in New Caney is $36,055 a year.     What is New Caney, Texas famous for?
    New Caney had begun as an agricultural town, but grew as the local lumber industry developed; among the timber products the town shipped were mining props used to support excavations. By 1892 the population level had risen to 150. The town had a telephone connection, three general stores, and a sawmill in 1914.Jan 6, 2021
